provenance.author: Codex, authored for the CargoGuard hackathon workspace
limitations: Not an external or blinded dataset.
The author had inspected the engine and existing tests; this is targeted challenge evidence, not unseen statistical proof.
Plain-text SI/BL sources only; does not measure OCR, PDF layout diversity, employee productivity, authentication or persisted amendment workflows.
Synthetic company names, example.test email and illustrative container identifiers; no live shipment claim.

references.title: BIC Container Identification Number
references.purpose: Check digit validates recording/transmission accuracy; does not validate shipment ownership or physical existence.
